title: Chapter 156 It'S Time To Make An Effort
content:
Chapter 156 It'S Time To Make An Effort

I don't know how long it took.

Boom!

With a loud noise, Yan Lingyun suddenly exerted force, and the powerful force immediately shocked the Devouring Spirit to retreat thousands of feet from the void.

It didn't stop until it reached the edge of the border.

"I have to say that you are the most terrifying opponent I have ever seen."

At this time, the Devouring Spirit wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth and suddenly spoke.

"Are you interested in working with my Devouring Spirit Clan?"

As soon as this was said, not only Yan Lingyun, but also the rest of the Divine Dynasty were a little unbelievable.

How could they suddenly want to cooperate in the fight?

Yan Lingyun frowned.

"Let me cooperate with you? Ask yourself, are you worthy?"

"Ah? Tell me, are you worthy?"

Yan Lingyun was a little angry at the moment. She felt that the Devouring Spirit was insulting him by saying this to her.

What kind of cow and horse is worthy of cooperating with him.

Hearing Yan Lingyun's words, the Devouring Spirit was not angry.

"Woman, I can't beat you, but you can't do anything to me either?"

"As long as I flee back to my Soul Devouring Clan now, what can you do?"

"So, since neither of us can do anything to the other, why can't we cooperate?"

These words make sense.

But Yan Lingyun sneered: "Haha, I can't do anything to you?"

"Why, can you kill me?"

Spirit Devouring looked fearless.

"If you really think so, I can tell you responsibly that your Soul Devouring Clan will no longer exist in the world from now on."

Obviously, Soul Devouring's words really aroused Yan Lingyun's competitive psychology, and the murderous intent became more turbulent when she looked at Soul Devouring.

"Woman, have you forgotten that you died tragically in my Soul Devouring Realm?"

"My Soul Devouring Clan is a hurdle you will never be able to overcome."

Hearing this, Yan Lingyun frowned slightly.

After a moment of silence, Yan Lingyun's face suddenly changed drastically.

"You are stalling for time!"

Then, Yan Lingyun looked behind her, or more precisely, in the direction of the Zhishen Star Domain Divine Dynasty.

And at this moment, a terrifying force suddenly attacked Yan Lingyun.

Boom!

The huge explosion shattered the void.

"Your Majesty!"

"Madam!!"

The smoke dissipated, and a figure slowly emerged.

Seeing that Yan Lingyun was safe and sound, everyone breathed a sigh of relief, but they did not dare to relax at all.

Because Yan Lingyun's face looked very bad at this time.

"You, are finished."

Yan Lingyun stared at the Devouring Spirit in the distance and gritted his teeth.

Hearing this, the Devouring Spirit immediately laughed.

"You just realized it now, isn't it too late?"

"Don't you want to build a force to stop my Soul Devouring Clan? Then I will destroy your hard work first, and then destroy you. At that time, the whole world will be the world of my Soul Devouring Clan!"

The arrogant laughter resounded through the sky.

Seeing this, Yan Lingyun could no longer bear it.

"Nirvana!"

Buzz——

A golden light suddenly condensed in Yan Lingyun's hand.

In just a moment, the surrounding space turned into a weird state.

"You, you actually hid such strength!"

Seeing this scene, Soul Devouring screamed, with a strong disbelief in his eyes.

They are both in the Transcendent Realm, why is the other party so much stronger than him.

This is unreasonable!

"You forced me to do this."

Yan Lingyun's face was cold, and then he punched out fiercely.

Boom!

At this moment, a huge gap was directly blasted across the entire unknown border.

And the scene in the unknown star field gradually appeared before the eyes of the world.

At the same time, to the Divine Star Region.

In the Divine Dynasty.

"Princess, please go first. Leave this to me."

The commander of the Imperial Guard, Qin Teng, said respectfully to Lu Xue with a serious face.

At this moment, he looked extremely nervous.

Not only him, but even the entire Divine Dynasty, no one thought that the enemy would come from a place they had never thought of.

Go straight to the heartland of their Divine Dynasty.

Because the general guarding that place is the first general of their Divine Dynasty.

The Great God!

And now, a terrifying army of the Soul Devouring Clan has come to their Divine Dynasty.

Almost all the way is unimpeded.

After all, most of the forces of their Divine Dynasty are already on the front line.

Now, except for a few people who are still in the Divine Dynasty, only he, the commander of the Imperial Guard, can come to the stage.

Hearing Qin Teng's words, Lu Xue looked indifferent, stood on the city wall, and slowly turned his head to look into the depths of the void.

There, a terrifying aura is constantly attacking here.

Obviously, there is not much time left.

"If they dare to come, let them come."

Hearing this, Qin Teng on the side was speechless.

After a moment of silence, Qin Teng still felt it necessary to remind the daughter that His Majesty brought back from outside.

"Your Highness, according to the intelligence from the front line, the strength of the Soul Devouring Clan is extremely strong. With this Soul Devouring Clan army coming here, its strength is far superior to ours."

"Forgive me for being frank, I'm afraid we can't hold on for long, so the best way is to ask for help."

After saying this, Qin Teng breathed a sigh of relief.

Now, Your Highness should understand what the situation is.

"So what, you are afraid of this shitty tribe, but I am not."

"Ah, this, Princess, "

"Okay, stop talking, I have my own plan."

Looking at Lu Xue's determined look, Qin Teng opened his mouth, but in the end he didn't say anything.

Alas, forget it, I believe that His Majesty will be able to resolve the battlefield and rush back immediately.

At this time, Ao Qing got out of Lu Xue's sleeve.

His mission was to protect Lu Xue, so he didn't go to the battlefield.

Ao Qing said something to Lu Xue, and Lu Xue's face suddenly brightened.

"Come here!"

The next moment, the space cracked.

An old man walked out slowly from the crack.

"Princess."

Seeing the old man, Lu Xue and Ao Qing said in unison: "It's you!"

The old man was Zhou Lao, who had been following Yan Lingyun.

Seeing Zhou Lao, the people around were a little surprised.

Even Qin Teng, the commander of the Imperial Guard, didn't expect that this old senior was still in the Divine Dynasty.

Great, if Elder Zhou is here, he will definitely be able to persuade Her Royal Highness the Princess.

Qin Teng thought so in his heart, and then looked at Elder Zhou with hopeful eyes.

Elder Zhou bowed respectfully to Lu Xue, "Your Highness the Princess, I am the old man that His Majesty secretly left behind to assist you. As long as Your Highness the Princess has any instructions, just let me know."

Hearing this, Lu Xue was slightly stunned, and her heart suddenly felt warm.

My dear mother.

Qin Teng on the side froze his smile.

Why is this happening?

"Elder Zhou, before, when we conquered some star domain forces, did we leave some strong men behind?"

At this time, Lu Xue spoke.

Hearing this, Elder Zhou nodded, "Princess, it is true. Although the Divine Dynasty has always been practicing hegemony, its methods are still relatively merciful. As long as you give up resistance, you can basically survive."

"Princess, do you want to?"

I saw Lu Xue smiled slightly, "Elder Zhou guessed correctly. Now that the alien races are invading, it's time for them to contribute."
